issues.description: Method getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): the problem statement's textual task description (problem_statement.md line 44) says the method should return a String with the format "LectureName (TotalNumberOfStudents)", while the UML in the same problem statement (problem_statement.md line 71) documents the method as returning void. The provided solution implementation (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 80) implements the method with return type String. This contradictory documentation (text vs. UML) can confuse students about the correct return type to implement and whether their implementation will match the tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the problem statement consistent. Update the UML in problem_statement.md to show getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): String to match the textual description and the solution, or change the textual description to explicitly state a void return if that was intended. Additionally, clarify the intended signature in the template (e.g. add the method signature comment or stub: public String getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents()) so students implement the correct return type.
